The '''South Polar Trench''' was one of the secondary trenches of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]]. It was located on the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] southern hemisphere, between the [[Mid-Hemisphere Trench (South)|Mid-Hemisphere Trench]] and the south pole.<ref name="DSTC" />
